gherkin.scenario: Remove a label from a card
given: I am on the 4gaBoards site and logged in with account demo@demo.demo / demo
when: Open the "Coverage Card Edited" card that has the "Coverage Label" label
Remove the "Coverage Label" label from the card
then: The "Coverage Card Edited" card should no longer display the "Coverage Label" label

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The "Coverage Card Edited" card should no longer display the "Coverage Label" label
